name: Entrepreneurship
overview: Scripture teaches that true entrepreneurship is empowered by the Lord, who gives the ability to gain wealth as part of His covenant faithfulness (Deuteronomy 8:18). Success and prosperity come from diligent obedience to God's commandments and meditating on His Word continually (Deuteronomy 28:1; Joshua 1:8). Wisdom and understanding are essential pursuits alongside material gain (Proverbs 4:7), and committing one’s work to the Lord ensures that plans are established and guided by Him (Proverbs 16:3). Ultimately, the Lord provides and sustains, making provision for every need (Psalms 23:1).
